result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a major missing navigation icon in the bottom bar. The horizontally clipped carousel/chip items and the partially visible card at the bottom of the viewport were treated as intended scroll indicators and not reported.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar has no icon above its label, leaving a blank gap between the Search and Profile tabs while Home, Search, and Profile all display icons.
issues.suggestion: Restore or add an Orders icon (e.g. receipt/list) above the 'Orders' label, matching the size, stroke weight, and inactive color of the other bottom navigation icons.
